## CVN X570 GAMING PRO V14

 •AMD X570晶片組; •CPU支持:支持AMD AM4架構Ryzen™ 2000/3000系列處理器; •內存支持：雙通道DDR4; •板載HDMI+DP接口; •RTL8118AS-CG千兆網卡; •SATA3.0/PCIE4.0/USB3.1 GEN1/TYPE-C; •2個M.2插槽(支持MSATA和PCI-e GEN4 x4 SSD); •2個12V 4Pin RGB風扇插針; •支持3-Way/2-Way AMD CrossFire™技術; •六大防護技術，產品運行更穩定; •200道工序嚴格測試，品質有保障; •PCB霧化工藝全面升級; •「410」優質服務，售後有保障; 

| 晶片組 | AMD X570 |
| --- | --- |
| CPU支持 | 支持AMD AM4架構 Ryzen™ 2000/3000系列處理器（TDP:125W) |
| 內存支持 | 4個DDR4內存條插槽，支持雙通道。搭載二代銳龍處理器：支持DDR4 2933/2800/2666/ 2400/2133MHZ規格內存；搭載三代銳龍處理器：支持DDR4 4000+(OC)/3800(OC)/3600(OC)/3200/3000/2933/2800/2666/2400/2133MHZ規格內存( 溫馨提示：內存超頻頻率還取決於搭配CPU和內存本身超頻性能。) |
| 顯卡支持 | 1個PCI Express4.0 x16插槽（當使用帶集顯的CPU，此插槽以x8頻寬運行），1個PCI Express4.0 x8插槽（當使用帶集顯的CPU，請不要使用此插槽。），1個PCI Express4.0 x4插槽, 支持3-Way/2-Way AMD CrossFire™技術。 |
| 存儲接口 | 提供6個SATA3.0 6Gb/s硬碟接口 |
| 擴展接口 | IO:1個PS2鍵盤和滑鼠通用埠、2個USB2.0接口、1個HDMI接口、1個DP接口、6個USB3.1 GEN1 接口（5個TYPE-A和1個TYPE-C）、1個千兆網絡接口、1組6孔八聲道音頻接口。板載：1個COM插針，2個USB2.0擴展插針，1個USB3.1 GEN1 TYPE-A擴展插針，2個12V 4Pin RGB風扇插針 |
| 擴展插槽 | 3個PCI Express4.0 x1插槽，1個PCI Express4.0 x16插槽（當使用帶集顯的CPU，此插槽以x8頻寬運行），1個PCI Express4.0 x8插槽（當使用帶集顯的CPU，請不要使用此插槽。），1個PCI Express4.0 x4插槽，2個M.2插槽（支持MSATA和PCI-e Gen4 x4 SSD） |
| 系統BIOS | 256M UEFI，BIOS語言支持中文簡體，英語，韓語 |
| 電源管理 | 支持ACPI S3/S4/S5/G3，支持PS2滑鼠/鍵盤開機，USB滑鼠/鍵盤喚醒，支持定時開機、來電開機、網絡S5喚醒 |
| 硬體監控 | CPU風扇轉速可控，CPU溫度監視，及各組電壓監視 |
| 板載網卡 | RTL8118AS-CG 千兆 |
| 板載音效卡 | Realtek ALC1150 8-CH HD Audio |
| 主板規格 | 245mm*305mm ATX |

Title: COLORFUL CVN X570 Gaming Pro V14 AM4 Motherboard Review - Back2Gaming
URL: https://www.back2gaming.com/review/colorful-cvn-x570-gaming-pro-v14-am4-motherboard-review/
Published: 2019-12-28T12:00:00.000Z
Author: BossMac Suba
Highlights:
We’ve taken a look at many COLORFUL products before, recently the COLORFUL RTX 2060 SUPER Vulcan X, and today we’re moving over to AMD check out what COLORFUL has in store in terms of motherboards. Today we have the COLORFUL CVN X570 GAMING PRO V14 AM4 motherboard which supports current AM4 processors including 3rd-generation Zen 2 Ryzen CPUs including the high-end Ryzen 9 3950X. The CVN line of motherboards from COLORFUL is inspired by battleships and the latest addition is the model that we have for today. We’ll check how it performs with a Ryzen 9 3900X so read on!

COLORFUL CVN X570 Gaming Pro V14 AM4 Motherboard Review

#### Features

- Supports AMD AM4 socket Ryzen™ 2000 and 3000 series Processors
- Supports Dual Channel DDR4 memory * when using Ryzen 2000 series processor,support 2933/2800/2666/ 2400/2133MHZ memory * when using Ryzen 3000 series processor,support 4000+(OC)/3800(OC)/3600(OC)/3200/3000/2933/2800/2666/2400/2133MHZ memory * Memory Overclocking:2/4 slots combination is more excellent * Warm Tip: Memory Overclocking also depends on the performance of the CPU and the memory itself
- 6*SATA3.0 ports
- 2*M.2 slots * Support MSATA and PCI-e Gen4 x4 SSD
- integrated 1000M LAN chipset
- Onboard 8-channel audio chipset
- DP+HDMI ports
- 2*4PIN 12V RGB LED headers
- 2*USB3.1 GEN2 TYPE-A ,7 *USB3.1 GEN1 & 6*USB2.0 ports(include headers)
- Support PCI Express4.0 standard

Official product page

...

The COLORFUL CVN X570 Gaming Pro V14 supports up to DDR4-4000 memory but this board doesn’t support XMP so you need to manually configure your memory if the quick settings don’t help.

...

At the back we have the I/O ports. We have a legacy PS/2 port, USB2.0 ports, video display ports via DisplayPort and HDMI used for Ryzen APUs. Continuing our look at the ports, we have USB3.1 Type A and Type C, a pair USB3.1 Gen2, another pair of Gen1 USB3.1 with a LAN port and the 5-channel audio.

...

## Test Setup & Methodology

Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 3900X Motherboard: COLORFUL CVN X570 Gaming Pro V14 Memory: G.Skill TridentZ RGB DDR4-3600 16GB Storage: WD Blue SSD 1TB SATA PSU: Seasonic Platinum 1050w Cooling: AMD Wraith Prism Monitor: Viewsonic VX2475smhl-4K VGA: NVIDIA GTX 2080 Ti FE

All tests are performed in an open bench with ambient room temperature kept at 30*C (welcome to the Philippines.)

Motherboards are updated to the latest BIOS during time of testing kept at their out-of-box settings aside from XMP frequencies when running stock benchmarks.

As many already know, most motherboards will have varying frequency multipliers and this may affect performance overall. As this is part of their out of the box configuration we see it fit to use them as is. All data presented here in are with the default motherboard settings for stock performance. Overclocked performance will be indicated where needed.

...

Performance is on par with many of the other X570 boards we’ve tested so far and COLORFUL’s CVN X570 Gaming Pro V14 is actually pretty decent especially for its price segment. That said, this board is fully functional and its mostly a get-in-and-get-out affair, just plugging everything you need and its good. The main drawback though in terms of usability to get the most out of performance is the lack of XMP support. Manually getting to DDR4-3600 was a trial and error that most user will probably never go through and that leaves a massive potential for underwhelming performance especially for those running faster memory kits. Fact is, you can still get your speed, but the BIOS doesn’t hold your hand when manually setting timings. BIOS also needs to be updated with more functional controls. Overclocking on this board is very limited but given its relatively entry-level positioning, this can be understandable.
